desc:
Become the villain in a ragdoll sandbox where every hit matters. Dummies react to exactly where and how you strike: they stumble, bleed out, get knocked out, or end up DEAD.

🦹 Unlock 39 weapons and villain powers: lightsabers, rocket launchers, lightning, laser vision, telekinesis and more
🧤 Snap your fingers with the Infinity Gauntlet and wipe out half the dummies
🩸 Realistic ragdoll physics with bleeding and HP that drains
🎈 Tie balloons to dummies, or to yourself, and float into the sky
💥 Start chaos events: Nuke, Black Hole, Dummy Rain, Zero-G, Fire Storm and Flash Freeze
🗺️ Switch between different maps, each with its own playground

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for updates!
👥 Join the group for a free bonus.

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Tablet and Console!
